## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and what changes for the user. Link a public issue if appropriate.

## Validation

State which checks were run and their results. Distinguish portable tests, cross-compilation and live Linux integration. For documentation-only changes, describe link/example/rendering checks.

## Compatibility and scope

Mention affected flags, dependencies, stored state, cleanup behavior or protection boundaries. Include screenshots for visual changes when useful.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves unrelated user settings.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation reflect the actual behavior.
- [ ] Untested paths and material limitations are stated above.
- [ ] No credentials, private keys or sensitive logs are included.
